title.en: Live vibe check: Notion backlog, Blender room rebuild, UI suite
title.zh: 直播实测：工单、建模与界面

summary.en: In a livestream, Carbon worked a frozen ~100-ticket Notion backlog, rebuilt the podcast room in Blender/Three.js/Unity over ~24 h (repeatedly crashing a Mac Studio), built a UI suite and took a Miami travel test, among other tasks. title.zh: 看一段视频，用 Three.js 复刻出来

summary.en: With early access, the author gave Carbon a video clip and it reproduced the scene in Three.js. The author calls Carbon a very good model that improves on Argon and thinks differently from Claude and GPT.
summary.zh: 作者提前拿到 Carbon，把一段视频片段交给它，它用 Three.js 把画面复刻了出来。作者评价 Carbon 比 Argon 有进步，而且思路和 Claude、GPT 不一样。

note.en: The thumbnail shows the source, a train-cab clip credited to Dr. Akiyoshi Kitaoka, next to the Carbon recreation.
note.zh: 缩略图把原素材（署名 Dr. Akiyoshi Kitaoka 的列车驾驶室片段）和 Carbon 的复刻版并排放在一起。

title.en: Underwater scene from a CUDA C++ VFX engine Carbon wrote
title.zh: 自写 CUDA 引擎渲染的海底鱼群

summary.en: A 3D scene Carbon made for the author using a custom CUDA C++ VFX engine that it also wrote.
summary.zh: Carbon 先写了一个定制的 CUDA C++ 视觉特效引擎，再用它给作者渲染出这段 3D 场景。

note.en: Subject (a school of fish underwater with light rays) is from the video thumbnail.
note.zh: 画面内容（水下的鱼群和透下来的光束）是从视频缩略图看出来的。

title.en: Orrery where one control drives gears and petals
title.zh: 一个控件带动齿轮和花瓣的天象仪

summary.en: The first of 13 coding briefs (3D, websites and apps) the author ran with early access in Antigravity. One control drives the orrery's gears and folding petals, even in reverse, and one follow-up improved the framing.
summary.zh: 作者提前在 Antigravity 里给 Carbon 跑了 13 个编程任务（3D、网站、应用），这是第一个：天象仪的齿轮和折叠花瓣由同一个控件驱动，还能倒转；追加一次指令后构图更好。

note.en: First post of a thread; the other briefs are in the replies. @xbquan reposted another clip from it: a web page running 1.04 million particles from one prompt.
note.zh: 这是一串帖子的第一条，其余任务说明在回复里。@xbquan 转发了其中另一段视频：一句提示词做出的网页，跑着 104 万个粒子。

creator: @noclipepe

title.en: Robotic eye that blinks, focuses, then explodes into parts
title.zh: 会眨眼对焦、再炸开成零件的机械眼

summary.en: One prompt: a robotic eye that blinks, focuses and then explodes into every part. Carbon took 29m 49s.
summary.zh: 一句提示词：机械眼先眨眼、对焦，再炸开成全部零件。Carbon 用时 29 分 49 秒。

note.en: Posted 28 Oct, before the 10 Nov API launch.
note.zh: 发布于 10 月 28 日，早于 11 月 10 日 API 正式开放。

prompt: a robotic eye that blinks, focuses, then explodes into every part.

title.en: Open valley scene in custom C++ with no reused assets
title.zh: 纯 C++ 写的山谷场景，零复用素材

summary.en: A scene made by Carbon on High reasoning effort in custom C++ with no reused assets, over two prompts; the author says the first result was already good enough and the second pushed it further.
summary.zh: Carbon 在 High 推理档下用自写 C++ 做的场景，没有复用任何素材，共两轮提示词：第一轮已经够好，第二轮是作者想再往上推。

note.en: Subject (a green valley with a stone bridge) is from the thumbnail. @laopai1990 and @Sin_Yiyao reposted the same video; the former likens it to Zelda: Breath of the Wild.
note.zh: 画面内容（一座石桥横跨绿色山谷）是从缩略图看出来的。@laopai1990 和 @Sin_Yiyao 转发了同一段视频，@laopai1990 说它像《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》。

title.en: 3D basketball court built without premade assets
title.zh: 不用现成素材的 3D 篮球场

summary.en: With early access, the author built a 3D basketball court with no premade 3D assets. The author found Carbon much better than Argon at anything involving taste and visuals: 3D, websites and motion graphics.
summary.zh: 作者提前用 Carbon 做了一个 3D 篮球场，没用任何现成 3D 素材。作者觉得在 3D、网站、动效这类看审美的任务上，Carbon 比 Argon 进步很大。

creator: @Stefan_3D_AI

title.en: Jeweled sea creature sculpted and animated in Blender
title.zh: 在 Blender 里雕刻并做动画的珠宝海马

summary.en: A 3D test that Argon failed weeks earlier, rerun in Antigravity on High. Carbon took 81 min and 186k output tokens (about $4.5 in API terms) versus Argon's 14 min, 11k tokens and about $1.8; the piece was made with the Higgsfield plugin in Blender.
summary.zh: 作者几周前用 Argon 做过同一个 3D 测试，结果很失望；这次在 Antigravity 里用 High 档重跑。Carbon 用时 81 分钟、输出 18.6 万 token，按 API 算约 4.5 美元；Argon 是 14 分钟、1.1 万 token、约 1.8 美元。用 Blender 的 Higgsfield 插件制作。

numbers: Gemini 4 Carbon: 81 min, 186k output tokens, about $4.5 in API terms
Gemini 4 Argon: 14 min, 11k output tokens, about $1.8 in API terms

comparison.verdictEn: Carbon delivered where Argon had left the author highly disappointed.
comparison.verdictZh: Argon 曾让作者大失所望，Carbon 这次交出了成果。

note.en: Subject (an ornate, jeweled seahorse-like creature) is from the thumbnail, which also reads "same prompt, rigged and animated in Blender".
note.zh: 画面内容（一只华丽、缀满宝石、形似海马的生物）是从缩略图看出来的；缩略图上还写着「same prompt, rigged and animated in Blender」（同一提示词，在 Blender 里绑定骨骼并做成动画）。

title.en: Grass meadow with 52k blades in CUDA and C++
title.zh: CUDA 和 C++ 手写的 5.2 万根草甸

summary.en: A grass meadow built from scratch in CUDA and C++ with no game engine or 3D library: 52k blades plus wildflowers. The wind sound is also synthesized in C++, so the audio follows the same gusts as the grass.
summary.zh: 用 CUDA 和 C++ 从零写的草地，不用游戏引擎也不用 3D 库：5.2 万根草叶加野花。风声也用 C++ 合成，声音和草被吹动的节奏一致。

note.en: Reposted with credit by @AnikaCodes.
note.zh: @AnikaCodes 注明出处后转发了。

title.en: Island castle and dragon: first prompt vs three follow-ups
title.zh: 岛屿城堡与龙：首轮 vs 追问三轮

summary.en: The same island, castle and dragon after Carbon's first prompt and after three more follow-ups: in the first pass the fire is nine orange cubes, after the follow-ups it looks almost real. The author's takeaway is that the gap comes from the follow-ups, not the model.
summary.zh: 同一座岛、同一座城堡、同一条龙，对比 Carbon 第一轮输出和再追问三轮后的结果：第一轮的火是 9 个橙色方块，追问后的火几乎能感到热度。作者的结论：差距来自追问，而不是模型。

note.en: Posted 30 Oct, before the 10 Nov API launch.
note.zh: 发布于 10 月 30 日，早于 11 月 10 日 API 正式开放。

creator: @kasmiyouness1

title.en: Realistic interactive 3D horse from the classic horse prompt
title.zh: 经典「三维马」提示词跑出的写实马

summary.en: The author ran the well-known horse test prompt on Carbon. After 38 minutes it produced a realistic, interactive 3D horse in Three.js.
summary.zh: 作者用流传很广的「马」测试提示词跑 Carbon，38 分钟后得到一匹写实、可交互的 Three.js 3D 马。

prompt: Create a realistic interactive 3D horse with three.js. Make no mistakes.

title.en: Aquarium with angelfish, snail and shrimp from a multi-tool pipeline
title.zh: 多工具流水线做出的整缸水族箱

summary.en: Carbon built an entire aquarium, including the angelfish, snail and shrimp, using Blender, Three.js, build123d and a local image-to-3D pipeline. Total time was about 6 hours.
summary.zh: Carbon 用 Blender、Three.js、build123d 和本地图生 3D 流水线做了一整个水族箱，包括神仙鱼、蜗牛和虾。总耗时约 6 小时。

note.en: Part of the author's thread of 7 builds made with early access.
note.zh: 出自作者用抢先体验权限做的 7 个作品的系列帖。

title.en: Koi courtyard with water reflections and swimming fish
title.zh: 有倒影和游鱼的锦鲤庭院

summary.en: The author's Koi Courtyard test: the environment, water reflections, lighting and swimming koi all impressed the author. The only downside noted is that Carbon is a bit slower than Argon.
summary.zh: 作者的「锦鲤庭院」测试：环境、水面倒影、光照和游动的锦鲤都让作者很满意。唯一的缺点是比 Argon 慢一些。

note.en: @AnikaCodes reposted it, describing ripples on click, a Feed button that brings the koi over, and a camera that dives underwater.
note.zh: @AnikaCodes 转发时描述了几个细节：点击水面会起涟漪，点 Feed 按钮锦鲤会游过来，镜头还能潜到水下。

title.en: Coca-Cola bottle drawn entirely in one shader
title.zh: 一个着色器画出的可乐瓶

summary.en: Carbon recreated a Coca-Cola bottle with math alone: no 3D models, no external assets, everything in a single shader, and the cap has all 21 teeth.
summary.zh: Carbon 只用数学重建了一个可口可乐瓶：没有 3D 模型、没有外部素材，全部写在一个着色器里，瓶盖上 21 个齿一个不少。

note.en: Posted 31 Oct, before the 10 Nov API launch.
note.zh: 发布于 10 月 31 日，早于 11 月 10 日 API 正式开放。

title.en: Minecraft-style test in Three.js using Antigravity voice mode
title.zh: Three.js 版 Minecraft 测试

summary.en: First results from the author's Minecraft test, built with Three.js in Antigravity and driven partly by voice mode. The author says Carbon came close to Opus 5.5 on this test and now wants to try harder agent and coding tasks.
summary.zh: 作者在 Antigravity 里（部分用语音模式）用 Three.js 跑了自己的 Minecraft 测试，认为 Carbon 已接近 Opus 5.5 的水平，接下来要试更复杂的智能体和编程任务。

title.en: 11.3 million voxels at 60fps in one HTML file
title.zh: 单个 HTML 里的千万级体素城

summary.en: Made while Carbon was shadow-routed under the name gemini-4-argon: 11,286,682 voxels at 60fps in one standalone HTML file, with moving viaduct trains, sky-harbor airships and three live lighting modes.
summary.zh: 这是 Carbon 还以 gemini-4-argon 的名义灰度路由时做的：一个独立 HTML 文件里有 11,286,682 个体素，60fps 运行，包含高架桥上行驶的列车、空中港口的飞艇和 3 种实时光照模式。

note.en: Pre-release: made while Carbon was served under the gemini-4-argon model name.
note.zh: 正式发布前做的：当时 Carbon 还以 gemini-4-argon 这个模型名提供服务。

title.en: Destroyed Coventry Cathedral rebuilt from floorplans and photos
title.zh: 用旧平面图和照片重建考文垂大教堂

summary.en: Carbon rebuilt the destroyed Coventry Cathedral from scratch by reading historic floorplan drawings and photographs, then generated a cinematic walkthrough video.
summary.zh: Carbon 读取历史平面图和老照片，从零重建了已被毁的考文垂大教堂，并生成了一段电影感的漫游视频。

title.en: Procedural mechanical falcon with a working watch movement
title.zh: 胸口装着机芯的程序化机械隼

summary.en: Built on early access: a fully procedural Three.js mechanical falcon with a live 28,800 VPH watch movement in its chest, a 4-bar wing rig and a 240 km/h dive. No 3D assets or external textures.
summary.zh: 提前体验期做的：纯程序化的 Three.js 机械隼，胸口有一个实时运转的 28,800 VPH 机芯，翅膀用四连杆结构，还能以 240 km/h 俯冲。没有用任何 3D 素材或外部贴图。

creator: @marcthecreatorr

title.en: Voxel floating kingdom with over three million voxels
title.zh: 超过 300 万体素的浮空王国

summary.en: A voxel floating kingdom with over 3 million voxels, made on high reasoning in Cursor in about 1 hour 15 minutes. The author puts the API cost at about $0.95 for an estimated 11.7M tokens.
summary.zh: 用 Cursor 高推理档做的体素浮空王国，超过 300 万个体素，约 1 小时 15 分完成。作者估算 API 费用约 0.95 美元，约 1170 万 token。

note.en: Cost and token figures are the author's estimates. A follow-up post (2120479775764459951) compares the same run with Opus 5.5.
note.zh: 花费和 token 数是作者估算的。后续一条帖子（2120479775764459951）把同一次运行和 Opus 5.5 做了对比。

prompt: Voxel Floating Kingdom

title.en: Eiffel Tower model built from old drawings and photos
title.zh: 用老图纸和照片建出的埃菲尔铁塔

summary.en: On launch day the author shared an Eiffel Tower model built with Carbon from old drawings and photos, saying the team found that Carbon's visual reasoning makes it strong at turning 2D into 3D.
summary.zh: 发布当天，作者展示了用 Carbon 从老图纸和照片建出的埃菲尔铁塔模型，并说团队发现 Carbon 的视觉推理让它很擅长把 2D 变成 3D。

note.en: The author writes "we discovered", which suggests a Google team member. @choblin29 posted a quoted description of the same demo next to Sundar Pichai's launch post: Antigravity /swarm agents turned historical photos and engineering plates into an interactive Three.js exhibition of the 1887-1889 construction from a single prompt.
note.zh: 作者用了「we discovered」的说法，看起来是 Google 团队成员。@choblin29 把这个演示的一段引述说明和 Sundar Pichai 的发布帖放在一起发了出来：Antigravity 的 /swarm 智能体只凭一句提示词，就把历史照片和工程图版做成了可交互的 Three.js 展览，展示 1887-1889 年的建造过程。

title.en: Space video made with code and Blender
title.zh: 只用代码加 Blender 做的宇宙视频

summary.en: A space video the author made with Carbon using only code and Blender. The author argues Carbon is no worse than Fable 5.2 and is fast, capable and uses fewer tokens.
summary.zh: 作者用 Carbon 只靠代码和 Blender 做的宇宙视频。作者认为 Carbon 不比 Fable 5.2 差，速度快、能力强、消耗少。

note.en: The thumbnail caption reads "Blender MCP · procedural modeling · zero external assets".
note.zh: 缩略图上的说明是「Blender MCP · procedural modeling · zero external assets」，即 Blender MCP、程序化建模、不用任何外部素材。

title.en: Little universe with planets, Milky Way and shooting stars
title.zh: 有行星、银河和流星的小宇宙

summary.en: Carbon built a small universe: planets, the Milky Way, shooting stars and detailed rings on Saturn.
summary.zh: Carbon 做了一个小宇宙：行星、银河、流星，还有细致的土星环。

title.en: Supercar chasing a steam train, scripted in Blender
title.zh: Blender 脚本里超跑追蒸汽火车

summary.en: Part of the author's tests of Carbon on Blender scripts: from one prompt, a supercar chasing a steam train with wet-road reflections and camera cuts, which came out better than the author expected. It took about 1h54m and $11.80.
summary.zh: 作者用 Carbon 测 Blender 脚本的一例：一句提示词做出超跑追逐蒸汽火车，有湿路面反射和镜头切换，效果超出作者预期。耗时约 1 小时 54 分，花费 11.80 美元。

note.en: Posted 8 Nov, before the 10 Nov API launch. Model listed as carbon-h.
note.zh: 发布于 11 月 8 日，早于 11 月 10 日 API 正式开放。模型标注为 carbon-h。

creator: @simonw

title.en: Yonkers stands up as a giant mech over New York
title.zh: 扬克斯变身机甲踏遍纽约

summary.en: Simon Willison asked Carbon in Antigravity for a Three.js animation of Yonkers standing up as a mech and stomping around Manhattan, Queens and Brooklyn using OpenStreetMap data. Willison also ran the pelican SVG at low, medium and high thinking, and had to add "build that into a standalone HTML file" to get a page with no external dependencies.
summary.zh: Simon Willison 在 Antigravity 里让 Carbon 用 Three.js 和 OpenStreetMap 数据，把扬克斯变成一台机甲，在曼哈顿、皇后区和布鲁克林来回走。Willison 还用低、中、高三档思考跑了鹈鹕 SVG；要拿到不依赖外部资源的网页，还得补一句「build that into a standalone HTML file」。

note.en: Made by Simon Willison (@simonw, original post https://x.com/simonw/status/2120258951594037732); shared with a Chinese summary by @ZSS_HK, whose post is the url here. Follow-up line used: "build that into a standalone HTML file".
note.zh: 作者是 Simon Willison（@simonw，原帖 https://x.com/simonw/status/2120258951594037732）；@ZSS_HK 转发并附了中文总结，这里的 url 就是 @ZSS_HK 那条帖子。用到的追问是：「build that into a standalone HTML file」（把它做成一个独立的 HTML 文件）。

prompt: Make a three js animation where yonkers stands up as a big mech (cool stand up motion) and stomps around manhattan and queens and Brooklyn, use openstreetmap mapping data

title.en: Cyclist riding a golden eagle, one-shot in Three.js
title.zh: 骑着金雕飞行的自行车手

summary.en: Pitched as an upgrade on the penguin-on-a-bicycle test: Carbon one-shotted this scene in Three.js.
summary.zh: 作者说「企鹅骑车」已经不新鲜了，于是换成这个场景，由 Carbon 用 Three.js 一次生成。

note.en: Subject (a cyclist riding a golden eagle above the clouds) is from the video thumbnail.
note.zh: 画面内容（一名骑行者骑着金雕飞在云层之上）是从视频缩略图看出来的。

title.en: Interactive New York City cruise tour in one HTML file
title.zh: 单个 HTML 文件里的纽约游船之旅

summary.en: An interactive 3D New York City cruise tour in a single HTML file with Three.js, with zero external 3D models or audio assets.
summary.zh: 用 Three.js 写在单个 HTML 文件里的纽约 3D 游船之旅，可交互，没有任何外部 3D 模型或音频素材。

note.en: The author credits a video by @Saboo_Shubham_ as inspiration.
note.zh: 作者注明灵感来自 @Saboo_Shubham_ 的一段视频。

title.en: Icelandic black-sand beach in Three.js over five rounds
title.zh: 迭代 5 轮的 Three.js 冰岛黑沙滩

summary.en: An Icelandic black-sand beach made from scratch in Three.js with no external assets; every basalt column, wave, sky and wet-sand reflection is generated in code. After 5 rounds the sky gradient, sea-stack reflections and wave bands worked, but the basalt close-ups still looked like plastic.
summary.zh: 只用 Three.js 从零做的冰岛黑沙滩，不用任何外部素材，玄武岩、浪花、天空和湿沙倒影全是代码生成。迭代 5 轮后，天空渐变、海蚀柱倒影和浪带都不错，但玄武岩柱特写改了 5 轮仍然有塑料感。

note.en: Posted on launch day as a pre-launch test.
note.zh: 发布当天发出，内容是发布前的测试。

title.en: Endless marble-run tower where every step plays a note
title.zh: 每级台阶都会发声的无尽弹珠塔

summary.en: Asked for a marble run with /swarm on, Carbon built an endless tower in one Three.js file: marbles roll through glass tubes, spin a paddlewheel and bounce down neon xylophone stairs that each play a note, then a lift carries them back up.
summary.zh: 开着 /swarm 让 Carbon 做弹珠轨道，它在一个 Three.js 文件里做了一座无尽高塔：弹珠滚过玻璃管、带动小水车，再沿霓虹木琴台阶弹跳而下，每一级都会发出音符，最后被升降机送回顶部循环。

note.en: The post mentions /swarm but does not name the tool.
note.zh: 帖子提到了 /swarm，但没说用的是什么工具。

title.en: Barbecue stall modeled in Antigravity
title.zh: 在 Antigravity 里建模的烧烤摊

summary.en: The author modeled a barbecue stall with Carbon in Antigravity and felt the details were somewhat better than an earlier attempt with Argon.
summary.zh: 作者在 Antigravity 里用 Carbon 建模了一个烧烤摊，觉得细节比之前用 Argon 做的好一点。

title.en: Running zebra in Three.js
title.zh: Three.js 做的奔跑斑马

summary.en: A running zebra made with Three.js. The author says the motion and joints are well done and close to Opus 5.5.
summary.zh: 用 Three.js 做的奔跑斑马。作者认为动作和关节都很到位，效果接近 Opus 5.5。

title.en: Rifle assembly and ballistics scene in Blender with no downloads
title.zh: Blender 里零下载素材的步枪组装与弹道

summary.en: Using only Python, Blender and Carbon with zero downloaded 3D assets: a part-by-part AK-47 assembly, live fire-mode switching, supersonic bullet-time and a ballistic watermelon destruction with custom foley audio.
summary.zh: 只用 Python、Blender 和 Carbon，没有下载任何 3D 素材：AK-47 逐个零件组装、实时切换射击模式、超音速子弹时间，再加上带定制拟音的西瓜弹道破坏。

note.en: An earlier post by the same author (2120443587100049782) shows the Blender viewport mid-build.
note.zh: 同一作者更早的一条帖子（2120443587100049782）展示了搭建到一半时的 Blender 视口。

creator: @sunset_evm

title.en: 5,000-drone light show over a night waterfront
title.zh: 夜色水岸上的 5000 架无人机灯光秀

summary.en: From one prompt in /swarm mode: 5,000 glowing drones in a single InstancedMesh at 60 FPS, with neon bloom, a skyline and reflective water. The drones swirl between four formations (spinning Earth, DNA helix, rainbow torus knot, flapping phoenix), with live FPS, formation buttons and sliders.
summary.zh: /swarm 模式下一句提示词做出的：5,000 架发光无人机放在一个 InstancedMesh 里，60 FPS，带霓虹泛光、城市天际线和反光水面。无人机在旋转地球、DNA 双螺旋、彩虹环面结、扇翅凤凰 4 种队形之间盘旋切换，还有实时 FPS、队形按钮和滑杆。

note.en: The quoted earlier post by the same author shows a playable Three.js Rubik's Cube that stays aligned after 100+ turns.
